Marcus, named in-game as Dead Fisher, was a fisher who died on the Ravaged Beach in Act One.

Involvement

Act One

Marcus' corpse is north of where the player character awakens in Act One at X: 296 Y: 253. After the Nautiloid fell from the sky, Marcus rushed to the crash site to search for survivors, but was charmed by a  Mind Flayer disguised as a beautiful woman. The creature enraptured him and several others, leading to their demise.

Speak with Dead

Marcus' corpse can be communed with using  Speak with Dead.

  • Who are you?
    • Dead Fisher
      Marcus... Fisherman...
      • What were you doing here?
        • Dead Fisher
          Saw the crash... came quick... try'n to help folk...
  • How did you die?
    • Dead Fisher
      Brains... didn't see 'em comin'...
      • Why didn't you notice the brains?
        • Dead Fisher
          Woman... beautiful... couldn't look away...
          • Where did the woman go?
            • Dead Fisher
              Went west... other followed... couldn't help 'emselves...
  • Were there any other survivors?
    • Dead Fisher
      Elf... ran north... up the beach...
